title: The iOS token emitter fails on a missing token, and its RFColorLight comment matches RFGlass
acceptance: build-tokens-ios.mjs stops with an error naming the token when a token it reads is missing or renamed, instead of emitting Color.clear (today swiftColor() does that for every token, so a renamed glass token would make the Mac's top bar see-through with no warning).

The generated RFColorLight comment no longer says glass has no light variant: RFGlass exists (dark only) and tokens.json has headerLight and borderLight. ios/RFTokens.swift is regenerated, and --check passes.
ritmofit-ios vendors the emitter's output through its own token build, so the iOS side is regenerated in an iOS PR if the generated Swift changes.
nextAction: Agent-created (Neo, 2026-11-22) from notes 1 and 2 of #779's final review, routed here when RF-233 started. Backlog until the owner sets Ready. Notes 3 and 4 (the README's emitter list and glass wording, and 08's glass row) landed with RF-233.
